description: FeedClaw is the content inbox for AI agents. Ask ChatGPT for a post, an X thread, or a newsletter, review it in the chat or in your inbox, then publish to X, LinkedIn, or email. Nothing goes out until you say so. First-time setup happens in the chat: name your brand, connect a channel from a link, and post. Attach photos or video, schedule ahead, manage several brands, and build subscriber lists.

defaultPrompt: What posts are waiting for my approval?
Show me my recent X and email published content.
